availability_audit: Post-game, play order 338, after the Champion and before Leaf (E0511, Altering Cave) and Steven (MeteorFalls_StevensCave). pool-100 is open except the three gate-100 entries, which are excluded on chronology because their source maps are those two later encounters: Mewtwo legendary_sign:AlteringCave_B1F, Iron Boulder and Iron Crown wild:MeteorFalls_StevensCave. Per pool-100 source_detail: Gastrodon gate 68 wild:ScorchedSlab_B1F/water_mons; Tapu Bulu gate 60 legendary_sign:Route123 (reachable legend); Kartana gate 20 wild:PetalburgWoods_3 (Ultra Beast wild); Chi-Yu gate 48 legendary_sign:AshenWoods (reachable legend); Gholdengo gate 48 evolution:level from Gimmighoul Chest; Whimsicott gate 14 Cottonee + Sun Stone. Every gate is at or below 68 and every source map precedes Cave of Origin in play order. Items are free Center stock (Leftovers, Assault Vest, Choice Band, Life Orb, Focus Sash). No Mega, no stone window needed.
plan: Built off attempt 6, which lost 6-5 with Melmetal at 59 HP. What worked there: Storm Drain Gastrodon takes literally zero from Water Spout and zero from Zapdos's Thunder, and its Earth Power OHKOs Lucario through Follow Me on turn 1; and Chi-Yu, arriving after the sea lifts, killed Zapdos and Zamazenta by itself. What lost it: Kartana's 98 Sp. Def meant Kyogre's Thunder alone nearly killed the lead, and Landorus is 4x weak to Kyogre's Ice Beam and evaporated the turn it entered. So the frail half is replaced with bodies the sea cannot punish. Leads Gastrodon and Assault Vest Tapu Bulu. Tapu Bulu resists Water Spout and Thunder, survives Ice Beam behind the vest (318 into 344), and Grassy Terrain Wood Hammer is 462-543 into Kyogre's 419 - a guaranteed OHKO, the same number that killed it on turn 1 of v3-a1 - while the terrain heals my side every turn of the grind. Gastrodon Earth Powers Lucario for 332-391 into 357, so the redirector dies on turn 1 whether or not Follow Me is up, and if Follow Me is up it dies to the very move it redirected. Kartana is now a reserve rather than a lead: Choice Band Leaf Blade is 467-549 into Kyogre from 348 Speed, faster than Zamazenta's 324, so it is the second independent guaranteed answer if Kyogre Protects or Follow Me eats the first one, and Sacred Sword ignores Iron Defense outright. Whimsicott's Prankster Taunt is aimed at Kyogre first (it Protected away a lethal Leaf Blade on turn 2 of attempt 6) and at Zamazenta second (Iron Defense and Protect are its whole kit); Encore pins a wasted turn. Gholdengo is the Ghost: Body Press and Close Combat are zero on it, Heavy Slam, Double Iron Bash, Water Spout, Ice Beam and Hurricane are all resisted, the roster has no Ground and no usable Fire, and Power Gem is 4x on Zapdos. Chi-Yu closes: once Primordial Sea lifts, Beads of Ruin cuts every foe's Sp. Def by a quarter and Life Orb Overheat OHKOs Zamazenta through any Iron Defense stage, Melmetal, Lucario, Zapdos and Marshadow from 328 Speed, with Heat Wave as the spread copy Follow Me cannot redirect - in attempt 6 that single Heat Wave killed Zapdos and Zamazenta on consecutive turns.
